purpose: Define a DWH query as an explicit machine-readable read/projection definition with stable identity separate from its execution, result set and source data.

topics.name: DWH Query Identity
topics.purpose: Define a DWH query as an explicit machine-readable read/projection definition with stable identity separate from its execution, result set and source data.

semantics.identity_rule: Reusable/saved machine-significant queries have explicit canonical identities.
semantics.execution_rule: Each concrete query execution has a distinct runtime execution identity.
semantics.source_rule: Query sources resolve exact DWH schema/instance/relation/resource identities.
semantics.parameter_rule: Query parameters are explicit typed bindings.
semantics.result_rule: Result-set identity is distinct from query definition and execution identities.
semantics.read_rule: Query semantics are read/projection semantics unless a separate materialization/write operation is invoked.
semantics.authority_rule: Query existence or successful resolution grants no source read authority.
semantics.path_rule: Query filename/UI name is not canonical identity.

invariants.rule: A DWH query is an explicit read/projection definition over exact resolved schema/instance/relation identities; querying, filtering, joining, aggregating, ordering or paginating never silently changes source ownership, identity or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: query definition identity reused as result identity
UI label becomes semantic query identity

references.purpose: Query sources resolve exact schema/instance identities.
